fields.label: blood-glow
fields.description: Open wounds and bleeding run red-bright. A surgeon sees everything — at the cost of bleeding faster.

fields.label: cranial glow
fields.description: The skull gives off a dim violet light through the scalp. A permanent, mounting euphoria that eats into sleep.

fields.label: eye-glow
fields.description: The eyes give off a steady gold light. It costs sight — deepfire cuisine's one true curse.

fields.label: gut-glow
fields.description: The belly glows faintly green, visible through clothes once it takes hold fully — a scavenger's gift.

fields.label: hair-glow
fields.description: Hair (or fur) glows in the pawn's own hair colour — a cosmetic gift that turns into a combat curse in the dark.

fields.label: lung-glow
fields.description: The breath itself runs warm and amber in cold air. Talk comes easier; breath comes harder.

fields.label: marrow-glow
fields.description: Nothing shows — the bones themselves are alight. A gift paid for in food.

fields.label: mouth-glow
fields.description: Teeth and tongue give off a low orange light — an ugly mark that somehow makes people better at haggling.

fields.label: nerve-glow
fields.description: Nothing shows — the nerves themselves burn brighter. Every scratch is sharper; the mind runs a little clearer for it.

fields.label: neural glow
fields.description: A faint white tracery under the skin at its worst. Speeds the body, costs the hands.

fields.label: body-products glow
